reason: Missing key/layer/hand conditions and independent predictive validation.

source.author: Arno Klein
source.score_meaning: Source-distributed predicted key-pair preference latent scores; not milliseconds or comfort percentages.
source.source_table_status: Predicted-score input distributed with the scorer. Fit/derivation not independently replicated.
limitations: Only same-hand pairs in two 12-key blocks. Right-hand values reflect the source symmetry assumption.
Central keys T G B Y H N, cross-hand pairs, digits, Shift/chords and spaces lack table support.
Source rule-generated full tables are deliberately excluded.
Per-pair uncertainty lacks joint covariance; no layout confidence interval is inferred.
Exact estimated_bigram_scores.csv fitting output and held-out predictive results are not pinned here.
source.use: Supported-pair diagnostic only; no comfort ranking, Pareto selection or replacement recommendation.
